title: Ha + Y --- The Fossil in a Three-Letter Word
label: ch:hay-etymology
canDo: I can say what hay is made of and name the French phrase built from the same pieces.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C54-ha-mas-y: name the two pieces, say where else the y appears, and name the French equivalent.
payoff.note: The y is Latin ibi, 'there', a word Spanish otherwise lost completely; it survives only because it was welded to a verb. French kept it separate as il y a.
